8.3.4.5 EcuM_GetShutdownCause
[SWS_EcuM_04051] Definition of API function EcuM_GetShutdownCause
Upstream requirements: SRS_ModeMgm_00023
⌈
Service Name
EcuM_GetShutdownCause
Syntax
Std_ReturnType EcuM_GetShutdownCause (
EcuM_ShutdownCauseType* shutdownCause
)
Service ID [hex]
0x1c
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Reentrant
Parameters (in)
None
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
shutdownCause
The selected cause of the next shutdown.
Return value
Std_ReturnType
E_OK: The service has succeeded
E_NOT_OK: The service has failed, e.g. due to NULL pointer
being passed
Description
EcuM_GetShutdownCause returns the selected shutdown cause as set by EcuM_Select
ShutdownCause. EcuM_GetShutdownCause is part of the ECU Manager Module port
interface.
Available via
EcuM.h
⌋
